verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਕਿਤੜੇ ਵੈਦ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਰੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe dhaate ma(n)gate kitaRe vaidh ketaRe rogee|

en.bdb: Many are doners, many beggars and many the physicians and the diseased ones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਿਤੜੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe sahaj sa(n)jog vich kitaRe vichhuR hoi vijogee|

en.bdb: Many being in the state of spiritual calmness are associated (with the beloved one) and many get ting separated are undergoing the pangs of separation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਭੁਖੇ ਮਰਨਿ ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa(n) bhukhe maran ketaRiaa(n) raaje ras bhogee|

en.bdb: Many are dying of starvation whereas many are kinds who are enjoying their kingdoms.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਸੋਹਿਲੇ ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਸੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa(n) dhe sohile ketaRiaa(n) dhukh rovan sogee|

en.bdb: Many are singing happily and many are weeping and wailing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆਂ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣੀ ਕਿਤੜੀ ਹੋਈ ਕਿਤੜੀ ਹੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: dhuneeaa(n) aavan jaavanee kitaRee hoiee kitaRee hogee|

en.bdb: The world is transitory; it has been created many times and still would be created again and again.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਹੀ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਦਗਾਬਾਜ ਦਰੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa(n) hee sachiaar ketaRiaa(n) dhagaabaaj dharogee|

en.bdb: Many are leading truthful life and many are cheats and liars.
Any rare one is the true yogi and a yogi of the highest order.
